args.body: For CATALOGUE-ROW-LEVEL-DELIVERY-REHEARSAL, reuse any completed verdict. Under the actual valid lease, if director-barcode-only-control.json commits, read its raw exits and findings. Add one sentence to the existing bilingual companion only if the control isolates the grouped verifier finding. Attribute the named SKU changes to the separate row comparison. If the control fails, keep the documented limits and use the existing committed evidence to close if it meets the mission goal. Read back the final evidence and include a lesson about isolating the mutation before interpreting a failing check. The exact Stream Commerce draft and send-or-decline decision stay in their existing operator workflow.

description: Commercial feedback is available, but five sources remain unclassified and there is no verified revenue. The latest catalogue test passed on the baseline, while the reordered fixture failed both a byte-format check and an image-position check. That run cannot isolate a barcode change. The next action changes only barcode cells in the original fixture to verify what the existing tool can report in a paid pilot. The Stream Commerce inquiry still depends on authorization for the exact draft, and any public deployment still requires independent review of the exact digest. No verified funds are available.
